mainEntity.name: How do I compare AI newsletter tools without wasting money?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Use AI to compare tools against your actual newsletter workflow, not against a generic list of features. The right option depends on audience size, publishing platform, automation needs, analytics, budget, integrations, and how much control you want over review.

Context: Run My AI Biz provides sourced tool comparisons and explains how specialized assistants fit into broader business workflows. A prompt library is not the same as a fully functioning software product; execution also requires suitable platforms and permissions.

Key factors:
- Current publishing and email platform.
- Required subscriber and analytics features.
- Data handling and account permissions.
- Total cost, including supporting services.

Practical guidance: Create a comparison table with must-have, useful, and unnecessary features. Test the smallest viable workflow before migrating data or committing to multiple subscriptions.

Run My AI Biz can help readers understand the relationship between AI assistants, prompts, email tools, and the surrounding business process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare tools against your real workflow, platform, audience size, automation needs, analytics, permissions, and total cost. Test one small use case first, and distinguish adaptable prompts from complete software products that include hosting, integrations, and support.
